comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled through 04296a7. The behavioral baseline remains the released Keiki 0.9.0.0 source previously reviewed in src/Keiki and keiki-codec-json; 9714d37..04296a7 adds only the OKF capability bundle and does not change watched runtime source, package versions, APIs, or catalog claims.

Reconciled e796227..89090cc from the watched source and package changelogs. The released baseline remains the tagged Keiro 0.11.0.0 five-package cohort. Post-release source adds exact workflow discovery and terminal arbitration, bounded concurrent resume and timer drains, UTF-8 deterministic identities, typed projection catalogs and resumable group rebuilds, candidate DSL Language 5 mapped consumers and semantic-local generation, Kiroku 0.4 checkpoint integration, and the unreleased keiro-ops package. Added six concepts and corrected the affected runtime, architecture, and messaging standards. The final 89090cc parser-benchmark commit changes benchmark coverage only and requires no catalog rule. Reconciled 89090cc..89ebe409 for the guarded external-read work: versioned catalog contracts, execute-only SQL wrappers, lifecycle-lock authorization, composite result ABIs, KR001/KR002/KR003 handling, Language 5 bounded all-row declarations, atomic versioned cutover integration, explicit retirement, and the Jitsurei client proof.

Reconciled 3009dda..6b6d637 from kiroku-store source, migrations, changelogs, Hackage, and tags. Kiroku Store 0.4.0.0 adds the public one-statement, member-aware durable subscription checkpoint inventory. Added kiroku/checkpoint-inventory and corrected subscription, telemetry, runtime-assembly, and operations guidance. Remaining commits are packaging, documentation, and capability-bundle changes with no additional runtime contract.
Reconciled 172df24..8c6ed5b. The range adds only the Shibuya OKF capability bundle; watched runtime source and package behavior are unchanged, so no catalog concept changed.

Reconciled b4cab75..9ee9a2f from all five package source trees, migrations, changelogs, Hackage, and the v0.5.0.0 tag. Added messaging/pgmq-queue-reconciliation for validated names, additive drift-aware reconciliation, notification crash recovery, Maybe-returning VT races, and the transient SQLSTATE whitelist; corrected PGMQ jobs and messaging gotchas. The watch paths intentionally cover each package rather than a nonexistent monorepo-level src directory.
